title: Start Valve generator foundations without inventing Siemens contract facts
goal: Begin product development for GEN-VALVE-001 in parallel with OLQ-VALVE-PROFILE-001 by implementing only contract-independent generator capabilities that are already required by issue #62, while explicitly deferring Valve FB parameter/dependency semantics until the real V21 contract is qualified.
scope: Implement only product code needed by issue #62 that does not depend on unknown fbValve_Solenoid parameter names, dependency names, versions, ownership claims or target prerequisites.

Add deterministic multi-artifact output manifest plumbing with generator/input/profile identity fields and generated-file SHA-256 hashes, allowing the profile/contract identity to remain an explicit required input placeholder rather than fabricated Siemens data.
Add output-root containment for all generated files.

Add centralized Siemens engineering-name/symbol validation/allocation sufficient to reject null/empty names, invalid names and case-insensitive duplicate symbols without silently rewriting unknown Valve semantics.

Add stable diagnostics for malformed/omitted type information, unsupported enum tokens, duplicate symbols, invalid names and output containment violations where these checks are independent of the final Valve FB interface.
Add focused Linux tests proving deterministic bytes/manifest hashes, duplicate/invalid-name rejection and output containment.

Do not add Valve FB calls, guessed parameter lists, guessed dependency names, guessed DB/instance ownership, guessed Open Library versions, TIA/Windows execution, React Flow, generic graph scheduling, plugin frameworks, catalog abstractions or IndustrialMDE changes.
The follow-up completion step for GEN-VALVE-001 must consume the real qualified contract from OLQ-VALVE-PROFILE-001 and add the exact typed Valve call/ownership semantics then.

requirements: Same input plus same explicit profile identity produces byte-identical generated artifacts and manifest.
Manifest contains generator identity, input identity, explicit profile identity and SHA-256 for every emitted artifact.
Every output path is proven contained beneath the requested output root before write.
Null/empty required names, invalid engineering names and case-insensitive duplicate symbols fail with stable diagnostic codes and locations.
Malformed or omitted required type tokens and unsupported enum tokens fail rather than silently defaulting semantics.
Existing Motor UDT regression remains green.
No code or test asserts any unqualified fbValve_Solenoid parameter, dependency, version, ownership, DB or target prerequisite fact.
Linux-only candidate validation; no candidate Windows/TIA execution.
